# pidginhost_kubernetes_node_pool (Resource)

A pool of worker nodes in a Kubernetes cluster. A cluster holds at most one pool per package and generation. The first pool, created with the cluster, can be imported and managed here too. Pool changes in the same cluster run one at a time within a provider instance. Shrinking and deleting wait for their own removal operation; failed removals return an error. Failed creation keeps deletion consent and timeouts in state for cleanup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_kubernetes_node_pool" "workers" {
  cluster_id = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  package    = "k8s-4"
  size       = 3

  # Required to shrink the pool or destroy it while it has workers: the
  # removed nodes lose emptyDir and local volume data.
  local_data_loss_accepted = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster. Changing it replaces the object.
- `package` (String) Worker package slug, from the pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_types data source. Changing it replaces the pool.
- `size` (Number) Number of workers, from 1 to 2147483647, subject to the cluster type limits. It changes in place; shrinking drains the removed workers and needs local_data_loss_accepted = true.

### Optional

- `generation` (String) Hardware generation slug. The API picks the default when left empty. Changing it replaces the pool.
- `local_data_loss_accepted` (Boolean) Accept that removing workers destroys data kept on the nodes themselves (emptyDir and local volumes). Shrinking the pool, or destroying it while it has workers, is refused without it.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <cluster_id>/<pool_id>.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Workers in the pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `pool_id` (String) ID of the pool within its cluster.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Node ID.
- `ip` (String) Node address, if assigned.
- `name` (String) Node hostname.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a node pool by "<cluster_id>/<pool_id>".
terraform import pidginhost_kubernetes_node_pool.workers 12/34
```
